meta.coverage: PDI is convenience-channel only and roughly an 8.6% sample of that channel (assumption D1, docs/ASSUMPTIONS.md - LOW confidence, no selection criteria published). The panel also grew 3.89x across 2019-2025, so density on this map is partly where PDI signed chains rather than only where the category sells. Read it as the shape of one panel, not as a census of US convenience retail.
meta.privacy: Stores are binned to a 0.1-degree grid (~11 km) and cells holding fewer than 4 stores are dropped. No store ID, exact coordinate, ZIP or per-store chain leaves the warehouse.
